title: [Decision] next codemod splits for the large hot files, in order, and whether to name a shrink-only line ceiling (hot-file card F)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Filing gate ③: maintainer-directed. On 2026-11-15 the maintainer chose 「今天改规则,并立全部 6 张卡」 on the hot-file serialization decision card (consequence as shown: 取消 protocol.ts 独占、关闭 #25467 和 #24586;卡 A 到 F 交各车道立卡,大 PR 和上限门禁仍逐个等您批准). Measurements: the hot-file analysis report (project artifact), re-runnable on request. Cross-lane rule (2026-11-15): no live seat in the owning lane, so `domain:server` seat 5 files and builds it; the owning lane is notified.

## Card F: decision for the maintainer

Which large files get the next codemod splits (the protocol.ts codemod precedent: #29998, #30687, #30954, #31177), in this proposed order:
1. `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`
2. `metadata-manager.ts`
3. `mcp-http-tools.ts`
4. `auth-manager.ts` + `auth-plugin.ts`
5. service-automation `engine.ts` + `plugin.ts`
6. `action-execution.ts`
7. `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`
8. spec `stack.zod.ts`

And whether the maintainer names a shrink-only line ceiling for these files (a new gate needs the maintainer's naming).

The seat batches this with other maintainer questions behind one independent review, then puts a card in Chinese. No dev before the ruling.
